meta.title: Ondra Weekly Skeleton
meta.description: Weekly report skeleton for Ondra (L9 extension pool, thin tier): turns "what happened this week" into a readable skeleton of four sections — what stayed (memories written this week), what is still hanging (unsettled promises), what she wrote herself (diary entries), and where the week was quiet. Each section states what to write there, what must be mentioned and what may be skipped, and carries a few quotable material snippets. Material comes from the memory service ondra-memory-core listFacts (ordered by created-at, filtered to the window), the promise service ondra-memory-prospective stats and listOpen (current stock, never dressed up as this week's new items), and the diary service ondra-diary list and entry (titles only, never the body). Every section carries mandatory sources naming the service, the field and whether it was read. A section that cannot be read has state not-available rather than 0, because 0 reads as "she remembered nothing at all this week" when the truth is that the number cannot be computed right now; no-material is reserved for an upstream that actually answered "nothing this week", and the two must stay separate states. A quiet week still produces all four sections, but it must say plainly that the week was quiet instead of padding it with old events. It never reports emotional scores, never grades, never evaluates, and never converts counts into trend percentages (once "happiness 7.2 this week" exists, someone will tune the persona to move the number). It does not write the finished text (assembling the report belongs to the app shell and the persona layer), does not send messages (that is O-042), does not render UI, installs no timers, and is not the source of truth for any statistic. All four upstreams are soft dependencies: whichever is missing is named in the missing list while the remaining sections still render.
